provenance.notes: Module models the basic short-body PA-28-235 (gross 2900 lb, 84 gal fuel, front arm +85.5 = TCDS Item VI, NOT the stretched Item XIII Pathfinder which is 3000 lb / front +80.5). Certified CG envelope transcribed from Item VI's LATER serial group (S/N 28-7110001 through 28-7210023), a 3-breakpoint taper matching the module structure: (+85.1) to (+93.5) at 2100 lb or less; (+86.0) to (+93.5) at 2600 lb; (+91.5) to (+93.5) at 2900 lb (straight-line variation). Two safety-direction corrections: (a) forward limit was a near-flat 82.0 rising only to 84.0 at 2900 lb -> certified 91.5 at gross = up to 7.5 in MORE nose-heavy-permissive than the TC (worst forward-limit defect in the S2 batch); (b) aft limit 95.5 -> certified 93.5 (module was 2.0 in too permissive AFT). The EARLIER serial group (S/N 28-10001 through 28-11378, NOTE 16) is a 2-point straight line (+81.5)@<=2100 -> (+91.5)@2900 also at aft 93.5 — the later group chosen as it is the higher-production 3-point taper and is more restrictive at low weight. Station arms front 85.5 / rear 118.1 / baggage 142.8 (200 lb at +142.8) / fuel 95.0 (84 gal: 50 wing + 34 tip, all at +95) confirmed CORRECT against TCDS Item VI. DEFERRED (Track B): empty_weight/empty_weight_arm nominal (TCDS Empty Weight C.G. Range: None); inverted climb cube (CLIMB_INVERSION_FD419) is a Track-B perf fix. Full findings: docs/fd-419-s2-piper-singles-wb-findings-2026-07-26.md.
